reels.caption:
We visited one of our subscriber's home!

Spanning three expansive levels, this Ealing estate pairs period scale with complete smart-home integration by Palladium AV, operating lighting scenes, electric gates, and climate controls via touchscreens in every room. From the restored antique lamp post and stained-glass entry foyer to the 3-meter-high ceilings, every detail balances architectural tradition with modern luxury.

The executive study caters to automotive passion with Ferrari artwork and direct garden views, while the formal reception room features coffered ceilings with hidden LED coving, a real gas fireplace with a limestone surround, and integrated Lyngdorf wall speakers.

Outside, the heated garden summer house enables year-round alfresco dining framing views across the neighboring cricket grounds.

Do you think we should tour your home next? Drop a yes in the comment!

Watch the full tour on The Luxury Home Show YouTube channel.

reels.caption:
Hidden deep within a peaceful pine forest, this two-story glass house offers breathtaking views from every angle. Watch heavy rain fall across the towering trees, lightning illuminate the misty sky, and a cascading waterfall flow into a tranquil river—all from the warmth of a cozy interior.

Wrapped in soft cream tones, natural walnut wood, and the comforting glow of a stone fireplace, every corner invites you to slow down, breathe deeply, and reconnect with nature.

Sometimes, the perfect escape isn't about sunshine—it's about finding peace in the rhythm of the rain.

💬 Would you spend a weekend in this forest sanctuary?
